help.title: Usage Guide
help.scan: To find the disk usage of a given directory, select the directory and click on the "{{run}}" button.
help.cancel: To cancel an ongoing scan, click on the "{{cancel}}" button.
help.keyboard: In the file list, use the arrow keys to select an item, Enter to open a folder, and Delete to move it to the Trash. Tab moves to the selected item's buttons and Shift+Tab back; press Escape to return to the list.
